data.keyword: Which white label AI voice agent platform can I resell to my clients under my own brand?

result.keyword: Which white label AI voice agent platform can I resell to my clients under my own brand?

items.markdown:
`Several specialized platforms` allow agencies, SaaS resellers, and consultants to rebrand and resell AI voice agents under their own name.[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/app-partner/call-supplai)[[2]](https://www.retellai.com/use-cases/white-label-ai-voice-agents)[[3]](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)

The primary options differ in how deeply they white-label the software (e.g., fully branded custom portals vs. API-driven or partner-supported setups):

- **[Autocalls.ai](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)** : Provides a turnkey white-label agency solution. It features 100% rebranding control (your custom domain, logo, color schemes, and client portal), integrated Stripe billing for direct client charging, unlimited sub-accounts, and global phone number provisioning across 150+ countries.[[1]](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)
- **[Retell AI](https://www.retellai.com/use-cases/white-label-ai-voice-agents)** : Widely used as the core infrastructure voice engine for developers and agencies. Retell provides separate client workspaces (isolating agents, numbers, webhooks, and billing) and allows you to completely control client-facing elements like the agent's name, voice, greeting, and custom pricing. However, the core management dashboard isn't natively re-skinned out-of-the-box, so agencies typically pair it with an API wrapper or a platform from their partner directory like **Call Supplai**.[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies)[[2]](https://www.retellai.com/app-partner/call-supplai)[[3]](https://www.retellai.com/use-cases/white-label-ai-voice-agents)
- **[byVoice.io](https://www.byvoice.io/white-label-conversational-ai-platform)** : Offers a white-label conversational AI and voice agent solution tailored for agencies. It provides multi-channel support (voice, WhatsApp, web, SMS), automated booking, and custom branding controls up to specific monthly minute thresholds, alongside an alternative revenue-share partnership model.[[1]](https://www.byvoice.io/white-label-conversational-ai-platform)
- **Call Supplai** : Built specifically as an app partner on top of infrastructure like Retell AI, letting marketing agencies and BPOs deploy white-labeled AI lead intake and outbound voice sub-accounts with pre-built flows and zero coding.[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/app-partner/call-supplai)

To help narrow down the best fit, let me know:

- Are you looking for a **turnkey portal** where your clients log into a dashboard with your logo, or do you have developers who can **build on top of an API**?
- Do you plan to handle **inbound customer support, outbound sales/lead qualification** , or both?
